name: DUCKVADER buyTokens mints the full supply to any new address for free
summary: DUCKVADER.buyTokens(amount) requires only msg.value >= amount ether and mints maxSupply (1e12 tokens) to any caller whose shadow _balances entry is zero, so buyTokens(0) gave every fresh address the full supply for nothing. The attacker's contract constructor deployed 400 helpers that each called buyTokens(0) and forwarded the tokens, then sold them into the DUCKVADER/WETH pair through the 99% sell fee; copycats repeated it until the pair was empty.

campaign.selection: transactions after the anchor in which DUCKVADER 0xaa8f3518 emits a Transfer from the zero address (a buyTokens mint) and the DUCKVADER/WETH pair 0x5858ca39 nets a WETH outflow

notes: The only mints before the anchor were the constructor's; the owner's later setBot(0, 99) set the sell fee the attacker paid, which the exploit did not need. Loss is the pair's WETH outflow in the anchor (5.036 WETH) and in the 321 copycat transactions (0.657 WETH); the minted DUCKVADER is valued at nothing (rule 12).
